question: Use the analytical tools to count all records in this configured dataset. Apply no date, category, status or geographic restrictions. Give the exact count, cite your analysis result, and say whether this dataset is real or synthetic.

dataset.source: authored fixture; not real NYC service requests
notes: Complete coverage means the full authored fixture, not source coverage of NYC.
Neighborhood identifiers and locations are synthetic labels, not official NTA assignments.
Closed FIX-013 deliberately lacks closed_date and closure_hours.
Two November records exercise repeated local DST time with distinct offsets.

catalog.description: Explicit starter category families. Validate against each real snapshot vocabulary before making completeness claims.

metric_definitions.count: Number of matching service requests; exact when execution is complete.
metric_definitions.closed_count: Requests with is_closed=true, including records whose closure duration is invalid or absent.
metric_definitions.open_count: Requests with is_closed=false. Administrative non-closed status, not proof that a case remains actionable.
metric_definitions.mean_closure_hours: Arithmetic mean of valid nonnegative created-to-closed hours in closed requests; excludes missing durations.
metric_definitions.median_closure_hours: 50th percentile of valid closure hours. Elasticsearch percentiles are approximate.
metric_definitions.p90_closure_hours: 90th percentile of valid closure hours. Elasticsearch percentiles are approximate.

semantics.closure: Administrative time to closure; not first response, confirmed resolution, or repair time.
semantics.neighborhood: nta2020 and ntaname require versioned official NTA polygon enrichment; never substitute ZIP codes.
semantics.trend: Descriptive reported-request counts and rates; not incidence, causality, or statistical significance.
semantics.relative_change: (current - baseline) / baseline; null when baseline is zero.
semantics.minimum_count: Aggregate threshold uses group count; comparison threshold uses combined baseline/current count. Applied before ranking; not statistical significance.
semantics.last_month: Previous complete calendar month in the requested timezone, anchored to as_of.

rules.unknown_keys: rejected; do not submit raw Elasticsearch DSL

operation.records: Matching requests; no group_by, aggregate metrics, or minimum_count.
operation.aggregate: Counts/metrics; empty group_by computes one overall group.
operation.compare_periods: Two non-overlapping creation-date periods; use periods instead of time; no date grouping.

dates.format: ISO 8601 datetime with explicit offset; normalized to UTC
dates.timezone: IANA timezone; default America/New_York; governs calendar buckets and exposure days
dates.as_of: Defaults to request time; anchors relative dates, not snapshot history or a data cutoff
dates.last_month: Previous complete calendar month relative to as_of; do not anchor to latest dataset record
dates.coverage: Comparisons and date histograms require complete declared coverage or a validated comparison_qualification for a reconciled observed snapshot. Disclose comparison_scope and warnings; observed reporting growth is not proof of worsening underlying conditions. Unobserved dates are not zero counts

filters.eq: One exact typed value; keyword matching is case-sensitive
filters.in: Nonempty array of exact typed values
filters.range: Date/number only; value has gt or gte and/or lt or lte
filters.exists: Boolean value; false selects missing fields; null is not an equality value
filters.category_family: {category_family: name}; use catalog.families; expands approved complaint_type values
filters.limits: Use describe_dataset.limits for filter depth/node/value budgets

geo.coordinates: WGS84 latitude [-90,90], longitude [-180,180]; distance in meters
geo.restrictions: One geometry; positive radius <=20040000m; simple nonzero-area polygon; no dateline-crossing bbox/polygon
geo.missing_location: Excluded from geographic queries; disclose map exclusions

group_by.date_rule: At most one date dimension; requires bounded time on the same field; weeks start Monday
group_by.zero_fill: Only covered calendar buckets; categorical combinations must be observed in the selected cohort

metrics.definitions: See catalog.metric_definitions; closure is administrative time to closure, not first response
metrics.missing_durations: Excluded from closure-duration metrics; closed_count still includes closed requests without a duration
metrics.percentiles: Elasticsearch median/p90 are approximate; inspect result.approximate

minimum_count.compare_periods: Retain groups with baseline_count + current_count >= minimum_count
minimum_count.order: Applied across complete groups before ranking; no significance claim

output_limits.preview_limit: Records preview 1..100, further bounded by configured max_preview_rows; default 100
output_limits.top_n: Aggregate/comparison first-page rows 1..100; default 20; not the full export cohort
output_limits.relative_change: (current_count - baseline_count) / baseline_count; fraction, null for zero baseline

rules.artifacts: Use saved result_id; explicitly choose all_matching or selected_groups and saved group_ids. Record exports use the full selected cohort, not the preview.

analysis_guide.examples_note: Illustrative historical dates and request parameters only; check actual snapshot coverage and catalog before execution. No expected findings are supplied.
